text:
Clara (AE): Prospect requires BYOK via customer AWS CloudHSM, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, and zero key material leaving their account unless explicitly contracted. They want: a POC runbook for encrypt/decrypt + rotation, a short SOW cost stub, and clear answers on escrow/split-knowledge.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a minimal POC that proves encrypt/decrypt, alias rotation, and a controlled revoke to show fallback. Keep it lean for procurement.
Hannah (Security): Security must see: CloudTrail KMS events forwarded to their log account, KMS key policy with explicit Deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion and kms:DisableKey on root, and conditions on aws:SourceVpc/aws:SourceIp where possible. Also confirm whether they want alias-switch rotation (transparent) or rewrap/rewrap-on-read.
Marco (SRE): For "no key material leaves account" we need Redwood Private in their VPC or an on-prem HSM integration. Network checklist: VPC peering or Transit GW, route tables, and an assumable IAM role ARN for redwood-service. Also need a maintenance window for rotation testing.
Clara (AE): Procurement asked if HSM-backed CMKs carry a monthly Redwood fee or if it's only customer-billed CloudHSM. Need a short bullet list.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Typical approach: CloudHSM costs are billed to the customer by AWS if the HSM lives in their account. Redwood adds: one-time integration SOW + recurring Private ops fee when we host dedicated appliances/monitoring. Hosted (our shared keys) has no per-CMK charge.
Hannah (Security): Add to procurement language: Redwood does NOT retain customer CMK material for BYOK flows. Escrow or copy is only by explicit contract and controlled key ceremony. For split-knowledge ceremonies (on-prem HSM) we support multi-operator unseal flows; document in SOW.
Clara (AE): Can we give them example numbers for procurement to evaluate? They said procurement is strict about line items.
Marco (SRE): Put a realistic stub (placeholder numbers, to be finalized in SOW):
- CloudHSM: billed by AWS to customer account (no Redwood markup)
- Integration SOW (network, grant setup, key ceremony validation): one-time $25,000
- Private hosting & ops: recurring $3,000/month (monitoring, patching, 24x7 on-call)
(We will refine after technical scoping.)
Noah (Solutions Eng): POC runbook draft (very short):
1) Customer creates an HSM-backed CMK in their AWS account and tags it "redwood-poc".
2) Customer adds Key Policy granting the Redwood service principal Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey and/or creates a KMS Grant.
3) Provide CMK ARN and an assumable role or grant token.
4) Run sample encrypt/decrypt via Redwood API and measure p95/p99 of KMS calls.
5) Perform rotation test: either alias swap (transparent) or create new key + rewrap step depending on customer's choice.
6) Revoke grant to simulate failure and demonstrate demo fallback to a non-HSM demo key ("clearly labeled, not for prod").
Hannah (Security): Security addendum: require CloudTrail forwarding, alerting on repeated kms:Decrypt failures, and 90-day retention for KMS-related events (adjustable). Also require an explicit SOW-approved exception process for key deletion.
Clara (AE): They also asked for a sample key policy to hand to their infra team. Can we include one?
Noah (Solutions Eng): Sample key policy (customer must edit ARNs/IDs):
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"*"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","kms:DisableKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{}}]}
Hannah (Security): Recommend adding Condition entries for aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp where applicable and a Deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion except via the SOW ticket number.
Clara (AE): Timeline: Prospect wants a kickoff in 3 weeks. What's realistic for Private+CloudHSM?
Marco (SRE): If they provide IAM role, peering/VPN, and security contacts promptly: 5-7 weeks for Private + CloudHSM integration (network, key ceremony, validation). On-prem HSM adds procurement/ops lead time, ~10-12 weeks.
legal-bot: Flagged: any reference to escrow or key custody requires legal review and a DPA/commercial appendix. Open ticket LEG-3381.
Clara (AE): Action items: Noah — assemble one-pager POC + sample payloads; Marco — draft SOW stub with costs; Hannah — prepare questionnaire answers and security addenda. I'll consolidate and schedule the kickoff.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll post the one-pager here by EOD tomorrow.
Hannah (Security): I'll attach the templated questionnaire answers and mark high-risk clauses for legal.
Marco (SRE): Creating ticket INF-4732 for cost estimate & SOW draft.
Clara (AE): Thanks team, I'll follow up with the customer and include the alternative for alias vs rewrap rotation in the kickoff agenda. :white_check_mark:
